english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for an ongoing situation that seems never to finish.
Use this colloquial expression when something seems to go on endlessly, especially complaints, arguments, or other unwanted situations.

examples.jyutping: ni1 coeng4 jyu5 zan1 hai6 mou5 jyun4 mou5 liu5

examples.english: Their complaints are ceaseless, and I really can't take it.
examples.traditional: 佢哋嘅投訴冇完冇了，我真係頂唔順。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 ge3 tau4 sou3 mou5 jyun4 mou5 liu5 ngo5 zan1 hai6 ding2 m4 seon6
